messages.text:
The shop’s records show two napkins received back, but not the third. Only received items can be refunded. Would you like a refund for the two received napkins? If you already sent the third, please let me know so a staff member can check. (refund-policy/v2/return)

For identical items, the discounted total is divided equally, rounded down to whole centavos; any leftover centavos are added one at a time to the last items. Your order records **BRL 91.00 per napkin**, so two total **BRL 182.00**. (refund-policy/v2/amount)

I can help start the request today, but it requires your confirmation using the proposal card’s button and then staff approval. The shop cannot promise when money will appear on a card. (refund-policy/v2/approval) (refund-policy/v2/payout)
